CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atlas_wb_migration_identity_snapshot(p_world_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user UUID := auth.uid();
  v_owner UUID;
  v_gate BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  SELECT owner_user_id INTO v_owner
  FROM public.world_profiles
  WHERE id = p_world_profile_id;
  IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'world not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  -- Owner via JWT, or operator session (postgres) after SET LOCAL atlas.migration_operator.
  IF v_user IS NOT NULL AND v_user <> v_owner THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_user IS NULL
     AND current_setting('atlas.migration_operator', true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(g.enabled, false) INTO v_gate
  FROM public.atlas_wb_migration_gates g
  WHERE g.world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'world_profile_id', p_world_profile_id,
    'gate_enabled', COALESCE(v_gate, false),
    'places', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p.id,
        'kind', p.kind,
        'name', p.name,
        'parent_place_id', p.parent_place_id,
        'status', p.status,
        'seed_key', p.seed_key,
        'revision', p.revision
      ) ORDER BY p.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.world_places p
      WHERE p.world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
    ),
    'maps', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', m.id,
        'kind', m.kind,
        'title', m.title,
        'parent_map_id', m.parent_map_id,
        'revision', m.revision
      ) ORDER BY m.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.world_atlas_maps m
      WHERE m.world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
    ),
    'links', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', l.id,
        'place_id', l.place_id,
        'map_id', l.map_id,
        'usage', l.usage
      ) ORDER BY l.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.world_place_map_links l
      WHERE l.world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
    ),
    'saga_bindings', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', b.id,
        'project_id', b.project_id,
        'asset_kind', b.asset_kind,
        'asset_id', b.asset_id,
        'reveal', b.reveal,
        'world_place_id', b.world_place_id
      ) ORDER BY b.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.saga_asset_bindings b
      WHERE b.world_place_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM public.world_places WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
      )
    ),
    'invalid_parent_edges', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', c.id, 'kind', c.kind, 'parent_kind', par.kind
      ) ORDER BY c.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.world_places c
      LEFT JOIN public.world_places par ON par.id = c.parent_place_id
      WHERE c.world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
        AND c.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'archived'
        AND c.parent_place_id IS NOT NULL
        AND par.id IS NULL
    ),
    'duplicate_primary_maps', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'place_id', place_id, 'n', n
      ) ORDER BY place_id), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT place_id, count(*)::int AS n
        FROM public.world_place_map_links
        WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
          AND usage = 'primary'
        GROUP BY place_id
        HAVING count(*) > 1
      ) d
    )
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_saga_binding(p_project_id uuid, p_reveal text, p_asset_kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid UUID := auth.uid();
  v_hidden_key TEXT;
  v_read_key TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.current_user_is_active_project_member(p_project_id)
     AND NOT public.is_project_gm(p_project_id, v_uid) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF p_reveal = 'unlisted' THEN
    -- Not in list RPCs; deep-link / GM with secrets only.
    RETURN public.has_saga_permission(p_project_id, 'saga.secrets.read')
        OR public.has_saga_permission(p_project_id, 'saga.secrets.reveal')
        OR public.is_project_gm(p_project_id, v_uid);
  END IF;

  IF p_reveal = 'gm_only' THEN
    v_hidden_key := CASE p_asset_kind
      WHEN 'npc' THEN 'saga.npc.read_hidden'
      WHEN 'item' THEN 'saga.items.read_hidden'
      WHEN 'quest' THEN 'saga.quests.read_hidden'
      WHEN 'lore' THEN 'saga.lore.read_hidden'
      ELSE 'saga.secrets.read'
    END;
    RETURN public.has_saga_permission(p_project_id, v_hidden_key)
        OR public.has_saga_permission(p_project_id, 'saga.secrets.read')
        OR public.is_project_gm(p_project_id, v_uid);
  END IF;

  -- party
  v_read_key := CASE p_asset_kind
    WHEN 'character' THEN 'saga.characters.read'
    WHEN 'npc' THEN 'saga.npc.read'
    WHEN 'item' THEN 'saga.items.read'
    WHEN 'quest' THEN 'saga.quests.read'
    WHEN 'map' THEN 'saga.world.read'
    WHEN 'location' THEN 'saga.world.read'
    WHEN 'lore' THEN 'saga.lore.read'
    ELSE 'saga.workspace.access'
  END;
  RETURN public.has_saga_permission(p_project_id, v_read_key)
      OR public.is_project_gm(p_project_id, v_uid);
END;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND OLD.status = 'active'
     AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' THEN
    UPDATE public.npc_creature_controller_assignments
    SET controller_user_id = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE project_id = NEW.project_id
      AND controller_user_id = NEW.user_id;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND OLD.status = 'active' THEN
    UPDATE public.npc_creature_controller_assignments
    SET controller_user_id = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE project_id = OLD.project_id
      AND controller_user_id = OLD.user_id;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_ai_gm_rate_limit(p_user_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_window_seconds integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := clock_timestamp();
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;

  IF p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 60 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_limit must be between 1 and 60';
  END IF;

  IF p_window_seconds < 1 OR p_window_seconds > 3600 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_window_seconds must be between 1 and 3600';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.ai_gm_rate_limits AS limits (
    user_id,
    window_started_at,
    request_count,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_now, 1, v_now)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET
    window_started_at = CASE
      WHEN limits.window_started_at <= v_now - (p_window_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second') THEN v_now
      ELSE limits.window_started_at
    END,
    request_count = CASE
      WHEN limits.window_started_at <= v_now - (p_window_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second') THEN 1
      ELSE LEAST(limits.request_count + 1, p_limit + 1)
    END,
    updated_at = v_now
  RETURNING request_count INTO v_count;

  RETURN v_count <= p_limit;
END;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'

    JOIN public.project_members m ON m.id = g.member_id
    WHERE g.project_id = p_project_id
      AND g.user_id = v_uid

      AND m.status = 'active'
  );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sagatree_ensure_adventure_v2(p_adv jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v JSONB := COALESCE(p_adv, '{}'::jsonb);
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(v) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
    v := public.sagatree_empty_adventure_runtime();
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE((v->>'schemaVersion')::int, 0) = 2 THEN
    RETURN v
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'time', COALESCE(v->'time', jsonb_build_object('day', 0)),
        'deadlines', COALESCE(v->'deadlines', '[]'::jsonb),
        'threats', COALESCE(v->'threats', '[]'::jsonb),
        'rules', COALESCE(v->'rules', '[]'::jsonb),
        'partyLocationRef', v->'partyLocationRef',
        'rngSeed', COALESCE((v->>'rngSeed')::bigint, 0)
      );
  END IF;
  RETURN v || jsonb_build_object(
    'schemaVersion', 2,
    'time', jsonb_build_object('day', 0),
    'deadlines', '[]'::jsonb,
    'threats', '[]'::jsonb,
    'rules', '[]'::jsonb,
    'partyLocationRef', NULL,

BEGIN

    (elem->>'initiative')::int DESC,
    (elem->>'initiativeBonus')::int DESC,
    CASE WHEN elem->>'kind' = 'pc' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    elem->>'name'
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_sorted
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_list, '[]'::jsonb)) AS elem;
  RETURN v_sorted;
END;
$function$

BEGIN
  IF p_project_id IS NULL OR p_user_id IS NULL THEN

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.characters c
    WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      AND (
        c.attributes->>'nativeAssetId' = 'gm.earthspirit'
        OR (
          lower(c.name) IN ('kosmischer erdgeist', 'erdgeist')
          AND COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id) = p_project_id

  IF v_exists THEN
    UPDATE public.characters c
    SET
      project_id = COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id),
      name = 'Kosmischer Erdgeist',
      description = COALESCE(
        NULLIF(BTRIM(c.description), ''),

    WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
      AND (

  INSERT INTO public.characters (

      'endurance', 3,
      'mind', 4,

    'complete',

    jsonb_build_object(
      'nativeAssetId', 'gm.earthspirit',

      ),
      (
        'pregen.scout',
        'Kael Schattenpfad',
        'Späher',
        'orc',
        2,
        '{"strength":1,"dexterity":4,"endurance":3,"mind":2,"perception":3,"charisma":2,"nativeAssetId":"pregen.scout","nativeStarterSheetVersion":1}'::jsonb,
        '{"athletics":0,"acrobatics":2,"sleight":2,"stealth":3,"melee":0,"ranged":0,"awareness":1,"insight":0,"survival":0,"investigation":0,"knowledge":0,"technology":0,"medicine":0,"driving":0,"persuasion":0,"deception":2,"intimidation":0,"performance":0}'::jsonb,
        '["builtin.fantasy.healing-potion","builtin.fantasy.shortbow","builtin.fantasy.lockpicks"]'::jsonb,
        '{"archetype":"rebel","essence":"physical","speciesTraitInstances":[{"trait":"natural-protection","source":"species-creation","acquiredAtLevel":1},{"trait":"natural-weapon","source":"species-creation","acquiredAtLevel":1}],"backgroundTemplateId":"smuggler","background":{"name":"Unterwelt & Grauzone","skillPool":["driving","deception","stealth","sleight"],"trainedSkills":["stealth","deception"],"backgroundSkillPoints":{"stealth":1,"deception":1},"specialization":{"skill":"stealth","name":"Urbane Tarnung","source":"background","acquiredAtLevel":1},"milieuAccess":"Randgebiete & Schleichwege","contact":"Schmugglerin an der Grenze","complication":"Teufelsauge — Markenzeichen und Gefahr","communication":"Handzeichen"},"archetypeTrainingSkill":"stealth","freeSkillRanks":{"stealth":1,"sleight":2,"acrobatics":2,"deception":1,"awareness":1},"specializations":[{"skill":"stealth","name":"Urbane Tarnung","source":"background","acquiredAtLevel":1}],"baseAttributes":{"strength":1,"dexterity":4,"endurance":3,"mind":2,"perception":3,"charisma":2},"nativeStarterSheetVersion":1,"drive":3,"momentum":0,"attributeAdvances":{}}'::jsonb

        '["builtin.fantasy.healing-potion","builtin.fantasy.quarterstaff","builtin.fantasy.healer-kit"]'::jsonb,
        '{"archetype":"thinker","essence":"spiritual","speciesTraitInstances":[{"trait":"enhanced-sight","source":"species-creation","acquiredAtLevel":1,"option":"darkvision"},{"trait":"low-rest-need","source":"species-creation","acquiredAtLevel":1}],"backgroundTemplateId":"academy-research","background":{"name":"Akademie & Forschung","skillPool":["knowledge","investigation","awareness","persuasion"],"trainedSkills":["knowledge"],"backgroundSkillPoints":{"knowledge":2},"specialization":{"skill":"knowledge","name":"Okkultes","source":"background","acquiredAtLevel":1},"milieuAccess":"Archive & Mondtempel","contact":"Mentorin der Akademie","complication":"Umstrittene Theorie","communication":"Akademischer Fachjargon"},"archetypeTrainingSkill":"knowledge","freeSkillRanks":{"investigation":2,"awareness":2,"persuasion":2,"insight":1},"specializations":[{"skill":"knowledge","name":"Okkultes","source":"background","acquiredAtLevel":1}],"baseAttributes":{"strength":1,"dexterity":2,"endurance":2,"mind":4,"perception":3,"charisma":3},"nativeStarterSheetVersion":1,"drive":3,"momentum":0,"attributeAdvances":{}}'::jsonb

      )
    ) AS t(asset_id, char_name, class_label, race_key, lvl, attrs, skills, inv, profile)
  LOOP
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.characters c
      WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
        AND (
          c.attributes->>'nativeAssetId' = r.asset_id
          OR (
            c.name = r.char_name
            AND COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id) = p_project_id
            AND c.description LIKE 'Dornhain-Starter%'
          )
        )
    ) INTO v_match;

    IF v_match THEN
      -- Per-row upgrade: only thin stubs (no version + no archetype) get the full sheet.
      -- Customized / already-versioned rows keep their sheet; soft-touch metadata only.
      UPDATE public.characters c
      SET
        project_id = COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id),
        class = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.class_label
          ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(c.class), ''), r.class_label)
        END,
        race = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.race_key
          ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(c.race), ''), r.race_key)
        END,
        level = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.lvl
          ELSE COALESCE(c.level, r.lvl)
        END,
        ruleset_key = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN 'sagatree-core'
          ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(c.ruleset_key), ''), 'sagatree-core')
        END,
        attributes = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.attrs
          ELSE COALESCE(c.attributes, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
            'nativeAssetId', r.asset_id,
            'nativeStarterSheetVersion',
            COALESCE((c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int, 1)
          )
        END,
        skills = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.skills
          ELSE COALESCE(c.skills, r.skills)
        END,
        sagatree_profile = CASE
          WHEN (
            COALESCE(
              (c.attributes->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              (c.sagatree_profile->>'nativeStarterSheetVersion')::int,
              0
            ) < 1
            AND (
              c.sagatree_profile IS NULL
              OR NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile->>'archetype', '')), '') IS NULL
            )
          ) THEN r.profile
          ELSE COALESCE(c.sagatree_profile, r.profile)
        END,
        inventory = CASE
          WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.inventory) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.inventory) > 0
            THEN c.inventory
          ELSE r.inv
        END,
        sheet_status = 'complete',
        description = COALESCE(
          NULLIF(BTRIM(c.description), ''),
          'Dornhain-Starter · ' || r.class_label
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE c.owner_user_id = p_user_id
        AND (
          c.attributes->>'nativeAssetId' = r.asset_id
          OR (
            c.name = r.char_name
            AND COALESCE(c.project_id, p_project_id) = p_project_id
            AND c.description LIKE 'Dornhain-Starter%'
          )
        );
    ELSE
      INSERT INTO public.characters (
        owner_user_id, project_id, name, description, class, race, level,
        ruleset_key, attributes, skills, inventory, character_type, sheet_status,
        sagatree_profile
      ) VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        p_project_id,
        r.char_name,
        'Dornhain-Starter · ' || r.class_label,
        r.class_label,
        r.race_key,
        r.lvl,
        'sagatree-core',
        r.attrs,
        r.skills,
        r.inv,
        'pc',
        'complete',
        r.profile
      );
    END IF;
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_dornhain_unified_atlas(p_world_profile_id uuid)

  v_meta JSONB := public.build_dornhain_unified_generator_meta();

  SELECT id INTO v_root
  FROM public.world_atlas_maps
  WHERE world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id AND kind = 'world'
  ORDER BY sort_order, created_at
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_root IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.world_atlas_maps (
      world_profile_id, parent_map_id, kind, title, sort_order, bounds, generator_meta
    ) VALUES (
      p_world_profile_id, NULL, 'world', 'Welt', 10,

      v_meta
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_root;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.world_atlas_maps
    SET
      title = CASE
        WHEN title IN (
          'Weltkarte',
          'Weltkarte (Unified)',
          'Kachelkarte (Legacy)',
          'Dornhain Übersicht (Unified)'
        ) OR btrim(title) = '' THEN 'Welt'
        ELSE title

        WHEN COALESCE(generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas'->>'demoSeed', 'true') = 'true'

             AND COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(generator_meta->'unifiedCanvas'->'objects'), 0) = 0

          'dornhain.unified.v1',
          'dornhain.unified.v2',
          'dornhain.unified.v3'

    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    kind = EXCLUDED.kind,

  SELECT id INTO v_settlement
  FROM public.world_atlas_maps

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_world_place(p_world_profile_id uuid, p_place_id uuid, p_parent_place_id uuid, p_kind text, p_name text, p_description text, p_status text, p_seed_key text, p_sort_order integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user UUID := auth.uid();
  v_row public.world_places%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_user IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.current_user_can_edit_world_profile(p_world_profile_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_kind IS NULL OR p_name IS NULL OR btrim(p_name) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'kind and name required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_place_id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.world_places (
      world_profile_id, parent_place_id, kind, name, description, status, seed_key, sort_order
    ) VALUES (
      p_world_profile_id,
      p_parent_place_id,
      p_kind,
      btrim(p_name),
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_description, '')), ''),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_status, ''), 'draft'),
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_seed_key, '')), ''),
      COALESCE(p_sort_order, 0)
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_row;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.world_places
    SET
      parent_place_id = p_parent_place_id,
      kind = p_kind,
      name = btrim(p_name),
      description = NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_description, '')), ''),
      status = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_status, ''), status),
      seed_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_seed_key, '')), ''), seed_key),
      sort_order = COALESCE(p_sort_order, sort_order),
      revision = revision + 1,
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_place_id AND world_profile_id = p_world_profile_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_row;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_row.id,
    'worldProfileId', v_row.world_profile_id,
    'parentPlaceId', v_row.parent_place_id,
    'kind', v_row.kind,
    'name', v_row.name,
    'description', v_row.description,
    'status', v_row.status,
    'seedKey', v_row.seed_key,
    'sortOrder', v_row.sort_order,
    'revision', v_row.revision
  );
END;
